items.title: March 2023 Meeting
items.body:
The 2023 election cycle is heating up! With primary elections for NYC Council and District Attorney races in The Bronx, Queens and Staten Island, candidates are on the trail, meeting with voters and speaking about the issues. Stonewall Democrats will endorse in this cycle later this spring.

To ensure LGBTQ voices are heard and our members have time to speak with candidates about their issues, we invite candidates, SDNYC members, and the public to meet for an informal mixer. With five locations (one in each borough!) find the event closest to you, and get involved!

Locations:
Brooklyn: Pending confirmation

Bronx: Bar 47 - 47 Bruckner Blvd

Manhattan: Boxers HK(2nd Floor) - 735 9th Ave

Queens: Fresco's Grand Cantina (Upstairs) - 28-50 31st St

Staten Island: Crafthouse - 60 Van Duzer St

items.title: Join us 12/14:  The 2022 Winter Extravaganza
items.body:
SDNYC's WINTER EXTRAVAGANZA
DATE & TIME: Tuesday, December 14, 6:30 - 9:30 p.m.
LOCATION: The Spot, 599 Tenth Avenue, Manhattan
RSVP: via Facebook and invite your friends!
ADMISSION: Free
FOOD & DRINKS: Pay your 2023 SDNYC membership dues for access to an open bar from 6:30-9:30pm. (See below for info about becoming a dues paying member of SDNYC in advance to avoid the line at the door!) We will also have a cash bar for non-members & free hors d'oeuvres for everyone to enjoy.

SAVE TIME AT THE DOOR: JOIN SDNYC TODAY!
Whether you are a renewing member of many years or a first time member, your membership dues are what make all of the work possible.

● $30.00 -- Individual Membership

● $50.00 -- Family Membership (Maximum of 2 people per Family Membership)

● $10.00 -- Reduced Price Membership (People who are students, retired, disabled or financial need. No one will be turned away.)
